# A match on a call through an import that did not resolve reports the
# import, and nothing of the match: its arms' names are the members of a type
# the call never had. Checked as a directory, the arm's "undefined: failed"
# was reported ahead of the import, which a package reports last.

! sngl check app
stderr 'import "nope:./lib": unknown import scheme "nope"'
! stderr 'undefined'

-- app/app.sngl --
import lib "nope:./lib"

func use() int {
    match var x = lib.f() {
        failed { return 1 }
        ok { return 2 }
    }
}
